name: Huerta de la Obispalía (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided grey over blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Huerta de la Obispalía (a bishop's staff and mitre, a lion and a castle on red).
history: Municipal flag of Huerta de la Obispalía; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Huerta de la Obispalía arms — bishop's staff and mitre, lion and castle
